title: AI-assisted image analysis of in vitro oral cell morphology for early disease detection.
summary: The oral-cell imaging system detects disease with high agreement against expert cytopathology. The conclusion is limited to the study cohort, reference standard and validation described in the paper. The result is reported in the Bioinformation. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
